classification_rule.logic:
1. Check R_842 containment (parent gate G42): w_0 in [-0.942,-0.742] AND w_a in [-0.2,0.2] -> PASS (not this gate). 2. Outside R_842: apply w_0/w_a axis partition:
   - w_0 < -0.942 AND w_a-lock: A1 (-0.988<=w_0) or A2 ([-1.05,-0.988]) or C2 (<-1.05).
   - w_0 in [-0.942,-0.742] AND w_a out of lock: B1.
   - w_0 > -0.742 AND w_a in lock: B2.
   - w_0 > -0.742 AND w_a in [-0.5,-0.2]: B3.
   - w_0 > -0.742 AND w_a < -0.5: C1.
   - w_0 > -0.742 AND w_a > 0.2: C2 (phantom-thaw).
   - w_0 < -1.05: C2 (deep phantom).
